<!-- ==== ZS·P1 · 段2/3：壳脚本（标记【Zs2】）==== -->
<script>
(function(){
  var G = window.__ZS = window.__ZS || {};
  if (G._shell2) return;            /* 段级防重（日后升级改键名 _shell2→_shell3） */
  G._shell2 = 1;
  G.v = 'p1';
  G.MARK = '【ZS】';                 /* 截断哨兵：段3 需一致 */

  function lastRoot(){
    var all = document.querySelectorAll('.zs-root');
    if (!all.length) return null;
    var r = all[all.length - 1];
    for (var i = 0; i < all.length - 1; i++) {       /* 旧实例（多对话/克隆）藏掉防串扰 */
      var d = all[i];
      if (d !== r && d.style.display !== 'none') d.style.display = 'none';
    }
    return r;
  }
  function hoist(r){
    if (r && r.parentElement !== document.body) { try { document.body.appendChild(r); } catch (e) {} }
  }
  function ensure(){
    var r = lastRoot();
    if (!r) return null;
    hoist(r);
    if (!r.__zsBound) r.__zsBound = 1;               /* 预留：P2 起在壳内绑控件 */
    return r;
  }

  G.getRoot = lastRoot;
  G.ensure = ensure;
  G.open   = function(){ var r = ensure(); if (r) r.classList.add('zs-open'); };
  G.close  = function(){ var r = lastRoot(); if (r) r.classList.remove('zs-open'); };
  G.toggle = function(){ var r = ensure(); if (r) r.classList.toggle('zs-open'); };

  G.toast = function(msg, ms){
    var r = lastRoot(); if (!r) return;
    var t = r.querySelector('.zs-toast'); if (!t) return;
    t.textContent = msg;
    t.classList.add('zs-t-on');
    clearTimeout(t.__tm);
    t.__tm = setTimeout(function(){ t.classList.remove('zs-t-on'); }, ms || 2400);
  };

  /* 文档级捕获委托：壳内点击先经我手，处理后阻断外泄 */
  if (!document.__zsD1) {
    document.__zsD1 = 1;
    document.addEventListener('click', function(e){
      var t = e.target;
      if (!t || !t.closest) return;
      if (!t.closest('.zs-root')) return;
      if (t.closest('.zs-close')) { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); G.close(); return; }
      if (t.closest('.zs-ball'))  { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); G.toggle(); return; }
      e.stopPropagation();
    }, true);
    document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){
      if (e.key === 'Escape') { var r = lastRoot(); if (r && r.classList.contains('zs-open')) G.close(); }
    }, true);
  }

  /* boot：等结构 → 归位 → 验收期自动开壳一次（P7 换正式开场逻辑，删此段即可） */
  function boot(){
    if (!ensure()) { setTimeout(boot, 300); return; }
    if (!G._opened) {
      G._opened = 1;
      setTimeout(function(){ G.open(); G.toast('ZS·P1 骨架就绪'); }, 650);
    }
  }
  boot();
  setInterval(function(){ ensure(); }, 2000);        /* 平台重渲染兜底重挂 */

  /* 平台动 DOM 就归位（防被搬走/塞进带 transform 的容器） */
  if (!G._mo1) {
    G._mo1 = 1;
    try {
      var mo = new MutationObserver(function(){ hoist(lastRoot()); });
      mo.observe(document.body, { childList: true });
    } catch (e) {}
  }
})();
</script>

<!-- ==== ZS·P1 · 段3/3：通道探测台+读取管线（标记【Zs3】）==== -->
<script>
(function(){
  var G = window.__ZS = window.__ZS || {};
  if (G._probe3) return;            /* 段级防重（升级改键名） */
  G._probe3 = 1;
  var SENT = G.MARK || '【ZS】';

  function lastRoot(){
    var all = document.querySelectorAll('.zs-root');
    return all.length ? all[all.length - 1] : null;
  }

  /* ---------- 通道探测（P1 核心交付：这份报告直接决定①的最终拍板） ---------- */
  function probe(){
    var rows = [], W = window;
    function add(label, ok, text){ rows.push([label, text, ok ? 'zs-ok' : 'zs-no']); }

    /* ① 官方框架：消息直读 / 订阅 / 舞台 */
    var t1 = '未检出', ok1 = false, warn1 = false;
    try {
      if (W.CARD && W.CARD.messages && typeof W.CARD.messages.at === 'function') {
        var m = W.CARD.messages.at(-1);
        t1 = '✓ 直读 ' + String((m && m.content) || '').length + ' 字'; ok1 = true;
      }
    } catch (e) { t1 = '存在·调用异常'; warn1 = true; }
    rows.push(['框架·消息直读 CARD.messages.at', t1, ok1 ? 'zs-ok' : (warn1 ? 'zs-warn' : 'zs-no')]);

    var t2 = '未检出';
    try { if (W.CARD_INTERNAL && W.CARD_INTERNAL.messages && typeof W.CARD_INTERNAL.messages.watchReply === 'function') t2 = '✓ 可订阅'; } catch (e) {}
    add('框架·新回复订阅 watchReply', t2.charAt(0) === '✓', t2);

    var t3 = '未检出';
    try { if (W.CARD_AUTHOR && W.CARD_AUTHOR.stage && typeof W.CARD_AUTHOR.stage.render === 'function') t3 = '✓ 可挂舞台'; } catch (e) {}
    add('框架·舞台 CARD_AUTHOR.stage.render', t3.charAt(0) === '✓', t3);

    /* ② sdk 通道 */
    var s1 = !!(W.sdk && typeof W.sdk.on === 'function');
    add('sdk·事件 sdk.on', s1, s1 ? '✓ 有' : '未检出');
    var s2 = !!(W.sdk && W.sdk.message && typeof W.sdk.message.send === 'function');
    add('sdk·发送 sdk.message.send', s2, s2 ? '✓ 有' : '未检出');
    var s3 = !!(W.sdk && (W.sdk.stage || W.sdk.save));
    add('sdk·舞台/存档 stage/save', s3, s3 ? '✓ 有' : '未检出');

    /* ③ 消息节点 + 整页快照 */
    var n = -1;
    try { n = document.querySelectorAll('[data-chat="message"]').length; } catch (e) {}
    add('[data-chat="message"] 消息节点', n > 0, n >= 0 ? (n + ' 条') : '查询异常');

    var snap = '';
    try { snap = document.body.innerText || ''; } catch (e) {}
    var cut = snap.indexOf(SENT);
    if (cut >= 0) snap = snap.slice(0, cut);     /* 哨兵之后全是我们自己的界面，切掉 */
    add('整页快照（兜底读法）', true, snap.length + ' 字');

    return { rows: rows, snap: snap };
  }

  /* ---------- 渲染报告 + 采样（运行时用 createElement/textContent，不塞 innerHTML 数据） ---------- */
  function render(){
    var r = lastRoot(); if (!r) return false;
    var box = r.querySelector('#zsProbe'); if (!box) return false;
    var p = probe();
    while (box.firstChild) box.removeChild(box.firstChild);
    for (var i = 0; i < p.rows.length; i++) {
      var d = document.createElement('div'); d.className = 'zs-row';
      var a = document.createElement('span'); a.textContent = p.rows[i][0];
      var b = document.createElement('b'); b.className = p.rows[i][2]; b.textContent = p.rows[i][1];
      d.appendChild(a); d.appendChild(b); box.appendChild(d);
    }
    var samp = r.querySelector('#zsSamp');
    if (samp) samp.textContent = p.snap.slice(-700) || '（暂无内容）';
    G.read.latest = p.snap;
    G.read.at = Date.now();
    return true;
  }

  /* ---------- 读取管线骨架（P3 在此接正式解析：协议 v0 的 [环境]/数据块） ---------- */
  G.read = G.read || {};
  G.read.latest = '';
  G.read.at = 0;
  G.read.tail = function(n){ return String(G.read.latest || '').slice(-(n || 300)); };
  G.probeOnce = probe;

  /* ---------- 启动 ---------- */
  function boot(){
    if (!lastRoot() || !render()) { setTimeout(boot, 400); return; }
    if (!G._tick3) G._tick3 = setInterval(function(){ render(); }, 2500);
    if (G.toast) G.toast('读取管线已上线 · 见探测报告', 2600);
  }
  boot();
})();
</script>

<!-- ==== ZS·P1.6 · 深探针 v2：role/实时事件/舞台/剩余sdk对象（替换【Zs4】原内容）==== -->
<style>
.zs-root .zs-drow{font-size:10px;line-height:1.6;color:#d8d0c4;border-bottom:1px dashed rgba(206,170,116,.13);padding:6px 2px}
.zs-root .zs-drow .zs-dlab{display:block;font-size:9px;color:#9a8a70;letter-spacing:1px;margin-bottom:2px}
.zs-root .zs-drow b{display:block;font-weight:400;font-size:10px;color:#e6cfa0;word-break:break-all;white-space:pre-wrap}
</style>
<script>
(function(){
  var G = window.__ZS = window.__ZS || {};
  if (G._probe4b) return;          /* 防重（升级换键名） */
  G._probe4b = 1;

  function lastRoot(){
    var all = document.querySelectorAll('.zs-root');
    return all.length ? all[all.length - 1] : null;
  }

  /* ---------- 事件日志（v2：带 role） ---------- */
  G.evLog = G.evLog || [];
  function pushEv(name, detail){
    G.evLog.push({ t: new Date().toTimeString().slice(0, 8), n: name, d: detail || '' });
    if (G.evLog.length > 12) G.evLog.shift();
  }
  function digest(v){
    try {
      if (v == null) return 'null';
      if (typeof v === 'string') return v.length + '字「' + v.slice(0, 22) + '」';
      if (typeof v === 'object') {
        var role = v.role || (v.msg && v.msg.role) || '?';
        var c = '';
        if (typeof v.content === 'string') c = v.content;
        else if (typeof v.text === 'string') c = v.text;
        else if (v.msg && typeof v.msg.content === 'string') c = v.msg.content;
        else if (v.data && typeof v.data.content === 'string') c = v.data.content;
        var ks = Object.keys(v).slice(0, 8).join(',');
        return 'role=' + role + ' ｜{' + ks + '}' + (c ? ' ' + c.length + '字「' + c.slice(0, 20) + '」' : '');
      }
      return typeof v + ':' + String(v).slice(0, 24);
    } catch (e) { return '解析异常'; }
  }

  var CAND = ['*', 'message:done', 'message:sent', 'message:new', 'message:start',
              'message:stream', 'message', 'message:reply', 'reply:done'];
  function subscribe(){
    if (G.evReg || !window.sdk || typeof window.sdk.on !== 'function') return;
    G.evReg = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < CAND.length; i++) {
      (function(name){
        try {
          window.sdk.on(name, function(payload){ pushEv(name, digest(payload)); });
          G.evReg.push(name + '✓');
        } catch (e) {
          G.evReg.push(name + '✗');
        }
      })(CAND[i]);
    }
    pushEv('订阅完成', G.evReg.join(' '));
  }
  function trySub(){
    if (G.evReg) return;
    if (!window.sdk || typeof window.sdk.on !== 'function') { setTimeout(trySub, 600); return; }
    subscribe();
  }

  /* ---------- dump ---------- */
  function desc(o, cap){
    cap = cap || 16;
    try {
      if (o == null) return '——';
      var names = [];
      try { names = Object.getOwnPropertyNames(o); } catch (e) { names = Object.keys(o); }
      var parts = [];
      for (var i = 0; i < names.length && parts.length < cap; i++) {
        var k = names[i];
        if (k === 'length' || k === 'name' || k === 'prototype' || k === 'arguments' || k === 'caller') continue;
        var t = '?';
        try {
          t = typeof o[k];
          if (t === 'string' || t === 'number') t += ':' + String(o[k]).slice(0, 12);
        } catch (e) {}
        parts.push(k + ':' + t);
      }
      var extra = (names.length > parts.length) ? ('  …共' + names.length + '键') : '';
      return (parts.join('  ') || '（空）') + extra;
    } catch (e) { return '读取异常'; }
  }

  /* ---------- 节点扫描 ---------- */
  function scanAttrs(attr){
    var out = {};
    try {
      var els = document.querySelectorAll('[' + attr + ']');
      for (var i = 0; i < els.length && i < 60; i++) {
        var v = els[i].getAttribute(attr) || '空值';
        out[v] = (out[v] || 0) + 1;
      }
    } catch (e) { return '查询异常'; }
    var s = [];
    for (var k in out) s.push(k + '×' + out[k]);
    return s.join('  ') || '无';
  }

  /* ---------- 舞台只读探测 ---------- */
  function stageProbe(){
    var out = [];
    try {
      if (window.sdk && window.sdk.stage) {
        var vis = '?';
        try { vis = String(window.sdk.stage.visible()); } catch (e) { vis = '调用异常'; }
        out.push('visible()=' + vis);
        var el = null;
        try { el = window.sdk.stage.el(); } catch (e) {}
        if (el && el.tagName) {
          out.push('el()=<' + el.tagName.toLowerCase() + '> class=' + (el.className || '') +
                   ' dc=' + (el.getAttribute ? (el.getAttribute('data-chat') || '-') : '?'));
        } else {
          out.push('el()=' + (el === undefined ? 'undefined' : String(el)));
        }
      } else out.push('无 sdk.stage');
    } catch (e) { out.push('异常:' + e.message); }
    try {
      var as = document.querySelector('[data-chat="author-stage"]');
      if (as) {
        var cs = null;
        try { cs = getComputedStyle(as); } catch (e) {}
        out.push('DOM author-stage: ' + (cs ? ('display=' + cs.display + ' z=' + cs.zIndex + ' pos=' + cs.position) : '有'));
      } else out.push('DOM author-stage: 无');
    } catch (e) {}
    return out.join('  ｜  ');
  }

  /* ---------- message-frame 结构 ---------- */
  function frameInfo(){
    try {
      var fs = document.querySelectorAll('[data-chat="message-frame"]');
      if (!fs.length) return '0 帧';
      var f = fs[fs.length - 1];
      var attrs = [];
      try { attrs = f.getAttributeNames ? f.getAttributeNames() : []; } catch (e) {}
      var txt = (f.textContent || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').slice(0, 50);
      return '共' + fs.length + '帧；末帧属性[' + attrs.join(',') + ']；文「' + txt + '」';
    } catch (e) { return '异常'; }
  }

  /* ---------- 渲染 ---------- */
  function drow(label, text){
    var d = document.createElement('div'); d.className = 'zs-drow';
    var a = document.createElement('span'); a.className = 'zs-dlab'; a.textContent = label;
    var b = document.createElement('b'); b.textContent = text;
    d.appendChild(a); d.appendChild(b);
    return d;
  }
  function render(){
    var r = lastRoot(); if (!r) return false;
    var bodyEl = r.querySelector('.zs-body'); if (!bodyEl) return false;
    var box = r.querySelector('#zsDeep');
    if (!box) {
      var sec = document.createElement('div'); sec.className = 'zs-sec'; sec.textContent = 'SDK 深探 v2 & 事件日志';
      box = document.createElement('div'); box.id = 'zsDeep';
      var foot = bodyEl.querySelector('.zs-foot');
      if (foot) { bodyEl.insertBefore(sec, foot); bodyEl.insertBefore(box, foot); }
      else { bodyEl.appendChild(sec); bodyEl.appendChild(box); }
    }
    while (box.firstChild) box.removeChild(box.firstChild);

    var W = window;
    box.appendChild(drow('sdk 根键', W.sdk ? desc(W.sdk, 20) : '无 sdk'));
    if (W.sdk) {
      var subs = ['message', 'composer', 'chrome', 'role', 'user', 'stage', 'input', 'save', 'cache', 'debug'];
      for (var i = 0; i < subs.length; i++) {
        var o = W.sdk[subs[i]];
        if (o !== undefined) box.appendChild(drow('sdk.' + subs[i], typeof o === 'function' ? 'function' : desc(o, 12)));
      }
    }
    box.appendChild(drow('事件订阅结果', (G.evReg || ['等待 sdk.on…']).join(' ')));
    box.appendChild(drow('[data-chat] 值分布', scanAttrs('data-chat')));
    box.appendChild(drow('[data-slot] 值分布', scanAttrs('data-slot')));
    var ta = 0, inp = 0;
    try { ta = document.querySelectorAll('textarea').length; inp = document.querySelectorAll('input').length; } catch (e) {}
    box.appendChild(drow('输入类节点', 'textarea×' + ta + '  input×' + inp));
    box.appendChild(drow('舞台探测（只读）', stageProbe()));
    box.appendChild(drow('message-frame', frameInfo()));

    var logTitle = document.createElement('div'); logTitle.className = 'zs-sec'; logTitle.textContent = '事件日志（最近12条 · 新→旧）';
    box.appendChild(logTitle);
    var logBox = document.createElement('div'); logBox.className = 'zs-samp';
    var L = G.evLog || [];
    if (!L.length) { logBox.textContent = '（监听中——发一条消息再回来看）'; }
    else {
      var lines = [];
      for (var j = L.length - 1; j >= 0; j--) lines.push(L[j].t + '  ' + L[j].n + '  ' + L[j].d);
      logBox.textContent = lines.join('\n');
    }
    box.appendChild(logBox);
    return true;
  }

  trySub();
  render();
  if (!G._tick4) G._tick4 = setInterval(render, 1500);
})();
</script>
